sentences.en: The subordinate characters are conceived with even more force and vividness; and the plot, which reflects precisely the struggles and aspirations of the period that immediately followed the Seven Years' War, is simply and naturally unfolded.

sentences.en: Finally, that principle in man which reflects upon actions and the springs of actions, unmistakably sets the stamp of its approbation upon conduct that tends towards the general good.
sentences.vi: Cuối cùng, nguyên tắc ở con người phản ánh dựa trên các hành động và lò xo của các hành động, không thể nhầm lẫn được đã đóng dấu xác nhận sự chấp thuận của nó đối với những hành vi hướng tới lợi ích chung.

sentences.en: The Abyssinian character reflects the country's history.

sentences.en: The history of the two cognate names reflects in some measure the development of Indian religious speculation generally.

sentences.en: When one reflects how active and prominent Langton and other prelates were at Runnim.ede the change is not surprising.

sentences.en: Every page is marked by transparent sincerity, and reflects the beautiful character of "holy George Herbert."
